body:
**Handoff from MMR-63 review (identified, not implemented).** Evidence: `evidence/runtime/world-wrap-probe.json`, docs `docs/runtime-capabilities.md` → "Periodic east/west seam".

- **Army members.** `MobileParty.DoUpdatePosition` IL_00ff–0112 steers an attached member by a planar difference: leader `NextTargetPosition` + formation slot − own `VisualPosition2DWithoutError`. IL_02a2–02bb then moves it at full speed.
  - `PeriodicSeam.RebaseAll` moves parties one at a time, so a member left on the other side of the seam from its leader sees about ±800 and walks the long way.
  - Rebase armies, and attached parties, together.
- **Direct `LocatorGrid<T>` callers that bypass the patched `MobileParty`/`Settlement.FindNextLocatable` wrappers:**
  - `MobilePartyAi.GetBehaviorForNearbySettlementToFlee` (settlement grid)
  - `PeaceBarterable.Apply` (party grid, r = 5, IL_009a/00ac/0112)
  - `MapTracksCampaignBehavior.QuarterHourlyTick` (track grid)
- **`NavigationHelper.FindPointAroundPosition`** (bandit and pirate spawns, naval patrol targets) has no canonicalizing postfix. Only `FindReachablePointAroundPosition` has one.
- **Locator image pass.** A search centred on a party that is non-canonical for one frame skips the image pass. `UpdateVisibilitiesAroundMainParty` runs after movement and before the rebase. Use a `[ThreadStatic]` recursion flag instead of "non-canonical centre = image pass".
- **Not run at the seam:** armies, sieges, raids, embark/disembark, moving-target pursuit. The locator image pass was tested from the east side only.
- The MMR-63 fixture is reusable: `build/research-wrap63/fixture-c`, probe `wrapProbe=1`. A full run takes about 13 min, mostly the All navigation cache at 419 s.
